message.text: Tracing the DeleteMemo API path to the store layer to identify dependent records deleted before the memo row.

The store layer's DeleteMemo in store/memo.go deletes memo_relation records where this memo is the source before removing the memo row itself.

It also deletes memo_relation records where this memo is the target, and attachments linked to this memo.

No other record types are deleted before the memo row. Reactions and memo_shares are not handled by the store layer's DeleteMemo.

args.command: grep -n -A 40 "func (s \*Store) DeleteMemo\|func (s \*Store) DeleteAttachment" /bench/repo/store/*.go; echo '======= shares on memo delete ======='; grep -n "DeleteMemoShare\|DeleteReaction\|DeleteInbox\|memo_share" /bench/repo/store/memo.go /bench/repo/store/*.go

message.text:
The store layer deletes memo_relation records and attachments before removing the memo row itself.

Comments are deleted by the API layer, not the store layer. Reactions are not deleted either.

q16.
memo_relation records (where the memo is source or target)
attachments linked to the memo

`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` deletes those first, then calls `driver.DeleteMemo` for the memo row. The API handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` deletes comment memos separately before that call.
